steps.en: A daily report of REPCCS transactions is produced automatically
steps.id: Laporan harian transaksi REPCCS dibuat otomatis
steps.why_en: No daily job builds this report; it is only made on request by staff.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada job harian yang membuat laporan ini; hanya dibuat saat diminta staf.

steps.en: The report is delivered to the officer's dashboard
steps.why_en: The report is only a menu item the officer must open; nothing is delivered.
steps.why_id: Laporan hanya menu yang harus dibuka petugas; tidak ada yang dikirim.

steps.en: The officer can download the report
steps.why_en: It is a download on request with a date filter, not the daily report in the story.
steps.why_id: Unduhan atas permintaan dengan filter tanggal, bukan laporan harian seperti di story.

steps.en: The report counts transactions that were given an admin fee
steps.id: Laporan menghitung transaksi yang dikenai admin fee
steps.why_en: The report has no admin fee column or count at all.
steps.why_id: Laporan tidak punya kolom atau hitungan admin fee sama sekali.

steps.en: The report counts transactions that got a payment reference number
steps.id: Laporan menghitung transaksi yang mendapat payment reference number
steps.why_en: The system never creates a payment reference number at this point, so there is nothing to count.
steps.why_id: Sistem tidak membuat payment reference number di tahap ini, jadi tidak ada yang bisa dihitung.
